examples.en: When customers do want to toss their pair, they can give them back to the store, which will repurpose and resell them.
examples.zh: 当顾客真的想扔掉它们时，他们可以把它们还给商店，商店会重新利用并转售它们。

examples.en: You can easily repurpose this function by adding a nonrequired argument.
examples.zh: 可以通过增加一个非必需的参数，轻松地改变这个函数的用途。

examples.en: Let me give you five examples of how to capture and repurpose daily activities for blog content.
examples.zh: 让我给你举5个例子看看吧。
